name: Kamille Bidan
source:
From: Mobile Suit Z Gundam
A teenage Newtype and pilot of the Zeta Gundam with the A.E.U.G. 17 years old. He started out as a somewhat sensitive but otherwise ordinary student going to high school on the space colony Green Noa. He had a complex about his name, Kamille, being traditionally a girl's name, so he threw himself into more "masculine" pursuits like flying homoavis (a simple type of glider) and karate.
